description:
Traditional Encino Home with Permitted ADU in Prime Location. Situated south of Ventura Blvd on a quiet cul-de-sac corner lot, this home offers privacy, comfort, and versatile living.
The main home features a classic layout with spacious living and dining areas, an expansive living room with vaulted ceilings, a marble fireplace, a granite built-in bar, and red oak hardwood floors throughout the first level. The kitchen includes a large center island, cooktop with professional hood, separate eating area, newer appliances, warming drawer and reverse osmosis water filtration.
The first floor features an oversized primary suite with French doors to the lush yard, a spacious en-suite bath, and a walk-in closet. A separate room on the main level is currently used as an office. Upstairs, there are views from the large arched window at the top go the stairs The 3 bedrooms offer high ceilings and great natural light, including generously sized rooms—one with a private balcony.  There is even a laundry chute that goes directly into the laundry room.

The backyard is private and tranquil with new eco-friendly turf and mature landscaping. Perfect for small gatherings or entertaining. 
Additional features include dual-zone HVAC, tankless water heater, EV charger, security camera system, wired for surround sound speakers, laundry chute, and attic storage.
The detached, fully permitted one bedroom ADU has its own separate address  private entrance on Rupert, dedicated full kitchen, separate bedroom, in-unit laundry, central HVAC, and a large rooftop deck with gas line for BBQ ideal for entertaining or extended living.
A wonderful opportunity in one of Encino’s most desirable locations.
